text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Westbank Projects Corp is currently redeveloping a number of properties located in the south-west quadrant of Bloor Street West and Bathurst Street and Bloor Street West and Markham Street. A temporary full closure of Markham Street, between Bloor Street West and Lennox Street is in effect to accommodate construction staging operations for the development. Toronto and East York Community Council, at its meeting on October 17, 2017, approved the subject construction staging area on Markham Street, from October 24, 2017 to October 31, 2019. Toronto and East York Community Council, at its meeting on October 10, 2019, approved a time extension of the construction staging area on Markham Street for an additional 26 months from November 1, 2019 to December 31, 2021.…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the continuation of the full closure of Markham Street, between Bloor Street West and Lennox Street, from February 29, 2024 to September 30, 2024 inclusive. 2. Authorized the closure of the north sidewalk on Lennox Street, between Markham Street and a point 20 metres further east, from February 29, 2024 to September 30, 2024 inclusive to accommodate construction staging operations. 3. Directed the applicant to continue posting a 24-hour monitored construction hotline number on the hoarding board, which must be prominently placed and legible from 20 metres and on all elevations from the construction site. 4.
